Additionally, **KW Books has released an early preview of the J3 illustration**, which was originally scheduled to be revealed at a later date!

Wishing the author a smooth and full recovery! ❤️

announcements.short:
@GSGW Releases

- **PART 3:** Chapters 382–391 moved to FANTL
-# Additional edits by Lei (me)
- **Manhwa:** Chapters 38–39

[Read GSGW](https://ireum.pages.dev/book/gsgw/)

Other Updates by Ender Oksam

- **Margin Settings:** Text and window side margins can now be customized using Default and Compact presets or adjusted manually with sliders to suit your reading preferences.
- **New Font Option:** Libron is now available in the font dropdown. If well received, it may become the default font. Alegreya will still remain available in the font list.

Performance Optimizations

A few changes have been made in an attempt to improve website performance and reduce resource usage:

- **Background Images:** Compressed and converted to WebP, reducing file sizes from 2.4 MB to approximately 174 KB (over 90% smaller) for faster loading times.
- **Shader Quality:** Reduced shader quality and frame rate to improve performance, with minimal noticeable visual difference due to the background blur.
- **Text Animations:** CSS text animations now pause when outside the visible viewport, preventing unnecessary animations from consuming resources.
- **Scare Pages:** Scare pages no longer dim the entire page. Dimming is now limited to the margins, helping prevent lag spikes caused by full-page dimming combined with animated text.

-# See the attached image for where to find Margin Settings (Settings -> Window Settings).
